summary:
As a Chartered Accountant and corporate professional with 3.5 years of post qualification experience, I
have helped Accounting and Auditing firms deliver high-quality audits by leveraging technology driven
solutions. In the last 3.5 years, I have helped PwC successfully deliver high quality audit engagements
through effective use of technology and strict adherence to the auditing standards.

skills._method: flashtext_skills_section | fuzzy(accounting→Accounting(100%), auditing→Auditing(100%), risk assessment→Risk Management(100%), testing.→TestNG(86%), direct→Microsoft DirectX(92%)...)

Coached and guided the junior team members in achieving their professional goals and deliver high quality audit deliverables.

Executed review engagements for the clients across various industries and with Canadian GAAP, particularly for private entities
